title: The News of a Tooth
youtube_title: The News of a Tooth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Uma about news of a loose tooth, told with ceremony. Uma wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
